source: Meso et al. 2024, Cladistics 41: 135-155 (alvarezsaur body size evolution), Fig. 5: time-calibrated alvarezsaur tree drawn vertically, root at the bottom and tip names written upwards along the top of each branch, against a Jurassic-Cretaceous stage column at left; branches coloured by body-size change (blue, red, purple), open circles on some nodes, pale bands across the chart at four times. Image: census 2 figure (1526x2484 px), the embedded raster.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (genera)
gold_note: Vertical time tree, root at the bottom, read by eye. Branch colours change partway along some stems, which does not make a node. Albinykus's branch passes through the middle of the horizontal that joins Ondogurvel and Xixianykus and continues down to the node with Kol, so (Ondogurvel, Albinykus, Xixianykus) is read as one three-way node. No clade names are printed; the open circles mark nodes and are not encoded. 23 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children). Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
region_note: the tree; the stage column at the left (x < 230) is not part of it
